versions.changelog:
Initial release of Competitor Market Analyst skill.

- Performs professional price trend analysis and competitor product comparisons based on user-provided product information.
- Outputs structured analysis reports, including historical price trends, competitor comparison tables, and actionable insights.
- Utilizes search tools to gather up-to-date competitor and market data when required.
- Presents key results using clear data visualizations (line, bar, and pie charts) directly in reports.
- Ensures reports remain objective, data-driven, and accessible to non-technical users.
